rationale: The agent appears to have initiated an exchange via the tool call but did not explicitly confirm with the user before performing an order-changing write, which violates policy. While a user lookup by name and ZIP was invoked (suggesting an authentication step) and product detail lookups were made, the conversation shows no explicit confirmation prior to executing exchange_delivered_order_items. Additionally, the final message lacks a clear summary of what was changed, replacement item details, or confirmation that the replacements meet the user’s constraints (clicky/ RGB/full-size keyboard fallback, and Google Home–compatible thermostat). Given these gaps—especially the missing confirmation prior to the write and incomplete final information—the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
